βέλτερόν: βέλτερος — better; comparative of ἀγαθός, epic (= Attic βελτίων); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’better (it is)’
δαῖε: δαίω — kindle, set alight; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδαιε): ’kindled’
δόρποιο: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
εἴσιδε: εἰσεῖδον (used as aor. of εἰσοράω) — catch sight of; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἰσεῖδε)
εἶσ: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg., elided (εἶσ’ = εἶσι): ’goes, comes’
κηδόμενοί: κήδομαι — grieve, be troubled, care; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘grieving’
κρίνονται: κρίνω — separate, decide, pick out; pres. mid./pass. 3 pl.: ’are decided, are distinguished’
λαοῖσι: λαός — people, host; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
λεχέεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι
νηυσίν: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν) (= Attic ναυσί)
πίθεσθέ: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; aor. 2 imper. mid. 2 pl., accented before enclitic μοι
περιπλομένων: περιπέλομαι — revolve, come round; aor. part. gen. pl.: ’as they revolve, rolling round’ (of the years)
φέρῃσι: φέρω — bear, bring, yield; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φέρῃ): ’yields’
φύγῃ: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. subj. 3 sg. act. (with κε): ’may escape’
χαίρεσκον: χαίρω — rejoice; impf. 1 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’I used to rejoice’
ἀμβροσίη: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, divine, immortal; adj., fem. nom. sg., standing epithet of night
ἀργοὶ: ἀργός — swift or white (meaning disputed for dogs, both senses possible); masc. nom. pl.
ἄλγιον: ἄλγος — pain, grief; comparative adv. ἄλγιον used absolutely: ’an added grief, all the more painful’
ἄστυδε: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg. with -δε suffix: ’to the town’
ἐάσει: ἐάω — allow, permit, let be; fut. 3 sg.: ’will allow’
ἐΰξεστοι: ἐΰξεστος — well-polished, well-planed; masc. nom. pl.
ἐξαπόλωλε: ἐξαπόλλυμι — destroy utterly; perf. 3 sg., intrans.: ‘has perished, has vanished’
ἐξεφάνη: ἐκφαίνω — show forth; aor. pass. 3 sg., intransitive: ’appeared, came into view’
ἐπαυρέμεν: ἐπαυρίσκω — get a share of, enjoy (+ gen. or acc.); aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπαυρεῖν)
ἐρύσαντες: ἐρύω — draw, haul; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having hauled up’
ἑσταότων: ἵστημι — stand; perf. part. masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἑστώτων): ’standing’
ἔλυσαν: λύω — loose, untie, cast off; aor. 3 pl.
ἰφθίμοισι: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὀρθῶν: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. gen. pl.: ’standing upright’
ὁρμηθεὶς: ὁρμάω — set in motion, urge on; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’set in motion, impelled’
ὄσσοντο: ὄσσομαι — forebode, have a premonition of; impf. 3 dual
ὑπέρβιος: ὑπέρβιος — overweening, violent, arrogant; masc. nom. sg.
